navigation.scope: Production builds over gzip HTTP/1.1 on loopback; fresh browser contexts and disabled cache; one warm-up and seven measured rounds with alternating client order per route/profile. Headings plus two animation frames; no backend or real mobile device.
navigation.scenario: Initial login/home, then first signup navigation from login. Home events use an empty HTTP fixture.

authentication.scope: Production builds over gzip HTTP/1.1 on loopback; fresh browser contexts and disabled cache; one warm-up and seven measured rounds with alternating client order per route/profile. Headings plus two animation frames; no backend or real mobile device.
authentication.scenario: Login to home with an immediate fill and with 30 ms between keystrokes (34 characters total); same successful signin, empty events/inbox fixtures. Includes first-use code download before sending signin. Input and submit times are in-page marks; no websocket transport.
